title: fix: point the bare tts alias at free OpenAI TTS
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The bare `tts` alias now selects free `openai/tts-1` instead of paid-only `elevenlabs/eleven-v3`, avoiding 402 responses for Quest-Pollen-only keys using that alias. Requests without a model still default to `openai/tts-1` on `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech`. The `text-to-speech`, `eleven` and `elevenlabs` aliases still select ElevenLabs v3, as does the default for `/v1/audio/speech/with-timestamps`, since no free model supports timestamps. Alias and route tests now cover `model=tts` and model-less requests with a Quest-Pollen-only key. Prices, paid-only settings, providers, routes and fallbacks are unchanged.
